anchors.anchor_seat: seat cushion top centre (driver hip point), child of tug; face +Z

facing: +Z (tug drives toward +Z; the carts trail toward -Z)
sides: L/R = vehicle's own left/right: L = +X, R = -X
hierarchy: tug_cart_train > {tug > {tug_beacon, tug_steer_FL > tug_wheel_FL, tug_steer_FR > tug_wheel_FR, tug_wheel_RL, tug_wheel_RR, tug_hitch}, cartN_body > {cartN_steer > {cartN_wheel_FL, cartN_wheel_FR, cartN_drawbar > cartN_eye}, cartN_wheel_RL, cartN_wheel_RR, cartN_hitch}} for N = 1..3

rig.tug_drive: move/rotate tug (Ackermann, wheelbase 1.2 m, track 0.84 m); fixed rear axle at z -0.60 glTF
rig.tug_steer: rotate tug_steer_FL/FR about local Y +-40 deg (kingpin origin at x +-0.34, axle height)
rig.spin: rotate *_wheel_* about local X; tug r=0.20 m, carts r=0.15 m
rig.coupling: each cartN_eye must coincide with the hitch in front (tug_hitch for cart1, cart(N-1)_hitch otherwise). Simple follower: per frame, place cartN_body so its rear axle trails the eye, then yaw cartN_steer so cartN_drawbar points at the leading hitch
rig.cart_steer: cartN_steer = front turntable (Ackermann-free "fifth wheel" steering) - rotate about local Y; origin on the king bolt at axle height
rig.drawbar: cartN_drawbar hinges at the front axle clevis - rotate about local X to raise / lower (rest = horizontal, eye at hitch height 0.33 m)

nodes.tug: tow tractor body, seat, steering wheel, canopy (2.0 m), rear pin hitch
nodes.tug_hitch: Empty at the tug pin coupler (x=0, y=0.33, z=-1.050 glTF)
nodes.cartN_body: platform cart 2.0 x 1.1 m, deck 0.48 m, stake sides; origin on the ground under the turntable king bolt
nodes.cartN_steer: front turntable + front axle; origin at the king bolt (axle height 0.15 m)
nodes.cartN_drawbar: drawbar, origin on its hinge (front clevis)
nodes.cartN_eye: Empty at the drawbar eye centre (couples to the leading hitch)
nodes.cartN_hitch: Empty at the cart rear pin coupler
nodes.tug_steer_FL/FR: Empty on each tug front kingpin, parent of the wheel
